body: P1. Audited main 1ec1bfe677 vs v4.1.43. cps/api/auth.py:316 imports cps.api.admin, but ldap_import_create_user lives in cps.admin. Successful LDAP bind and directory details then throw AttributeError and become HTTP401. Real Flask route probe with mocked directory/user-query seams observed zero calls to the actual provisioning helper. New default SPA has no working first-login provisioning for these directory users. Import the parent-package helper; add HTTP provisioning success and rejection cases. Existing API auth tests have no LDAP login case. See pre-release audit 2026-09-08; independently reproduced twice.

resolution.note: Corrected parent-package provisioning import. Real SPA HTTP + SQLite provisioning/session regression fails on audited base and passes with fix; rejection and administrator disable switches covered. Auth regression suite: 63 passed. Not released; independent candidate verification follows.

title: LDAP auto-provisioning imports the wrong admin module and rejects valid first logins
